item_wooden_sword.name: wooden sword
item_wooden_sword.description: A plain sword of dark wood bound with cord. It cuts better than it has any right to.

item_small_shield.name: small shield
item_small_shield.description: A small round shield of dark wood. It turns thrown stones and little else.

item_bow.name: bow
item_bow.description: A short bow of yew. Each arrow you loose costs you a rupee, and is worth it.

item_boomerang.name: whirlwing
item_boomerang.description: A curved throwing-stick of pale wood. Thrown, it spins out, stuns what it strikes and comes back to your hand.

item_small_key.name: small key
item_small_key.description: A small iron key. It opens one door, and then it has done its work.

item_bomb.name: bomb
item_bomb.description: A fused ball of black powder. Lit where you stand, it hurts what is near, and some walls give way to it.

item_recovery_heart.name: recovery heart
item_recovery_heart.description: A small red heart that glows faintly. Held to the chest, it mends a heart's worth of wounds.

item_shard_1.name: first shard of the Starcrown
item_shard_1.description: A bright sliver of the Starcrown that once held Ardenmoor whole. It is warm to the touch.

item_shard_2.name: second shard of the Starcrown
item_shard_2.description: A bright sliver of the Starcrown that once held Ardenmoor whole. It is warm to the touch.

item_shard_3.description: A bright sliver of the Starcrown that once held Ardenmoor whole. It is warm to the touch.

item_purse_5.name: 5 rupees
item_purse_5.description: A few blue stones that pass for money in Ardenmoor.

item_purse_10.name: 10 rupees
item_purse_10.description: A few blue stones that pass for money in Ardenmoor.

item_purse_30.name: 30 rupees
item_purse_30.description: A few blue stones that pass for money in Ardenmoor.

item_pale_blade.name: pale blade
item_pale_blade.description: A sword of pale, ringing metal that was kept behind a waterfall. It cuts twice as deep as the wooden one.

item_stormwing.name: stormwing
item_stormwing.description: A great curved throwing-stick of grey wood bound in iron. It stuns for a long while and comes back to the hand.

item_raft.name: raft
item_raft.description: A flat raft of lashed logs, small enough to carry and big enough to carry you. Wherever there is a dock, you can cross.

item_heart_container.name: heart container
item_heart_container.description: A glowing red vessel, warm and a little heavier than it looks. Take it, and you have more heart than before.

item_ladder.name: ladder
item_ladder.description: A light folding ladder of pale wood. Laid flat, it crosses any gap as wide as a person is long.

item_reed_pipe.name: reed pipe
item_reed_pipe.description: A little pipe of cut reed. Its tune is low and sweet, and some places in Ardenmoor answer it: a hill, a pool, a sleeping thing in the earth.

effects.message: You raise the reed pipe and play a low, sweet tune.

item_wyrmrod.name: wyrmrod
item_wyrmrod.description: A rod of black horn with a bronze tip. Pointed, it throws a bolt of cold fire that goes where you point it.

item_blue_candle.name: blue candle
item_blue_candle.description: A squat blue candle. Lit, it makes a room of light that stays while you stay, and it will burn anything that burns. It will light one room, once each visit.

properties.requires_message: The candle already burns in this room.

item_magic_shield.name: magical shield
item_magic_shield.description: A tall shield of dark wood faced with beaten silver. It turns thrown stones, arrows and most fire.

item_bomb_bag.name: bomb bag
item_bomb_bag.description: A leather bag with a drawstring and room for twelve bombs. While you carry it, twelve is your limit and not eight.

item_dock_heart.name: heart container
item_dock_heart.description: A glowing red vessel on a far dock, warm and a little heavier than it looks. Take it, and you have more heart than before.

item_bush_heart.name: heart container
item_bush_heart.description: A glowing red vessel that was hidden under a bush, warm and a little heavier than it looks. Take it, and you have more heart than before.
